result_text:
The contributor tables and the recent-commits bar chart no longer cut off at `contributorsListLimit`. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests, and I didn't generate a landscape report to check the output.

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`:** I removed the `.limit(limit)` from the table stream and deleted the "The list is limited to N items (out of M)." note. This class builds the all-contributors, recent, bots and teams tables, so they all list everyone now. The ordering is unchanged.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`:** the bar chart now loops over all recently active contributors, so it has one bar each.

I left the `contributorsListLimit` setting in `LandscapeConfiguration`. Nothing in the contributor tables or chart uses it any more.

I did not touch the separate `limit(100)` at `LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java:389`. It applies to something else (it appears to be a per-extension list).
